title: Twilio API key secret: one-property twin (context)
summary: 10 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: the same-line "twilio" keyword removed (TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET renamed BUILD_NONCE), context: the same-line "twilio" keyword removed (TWILIO_API_SECRET renamed CACHE_NONCE), and context: the same-line "twilio" keyword removed (TWILIO_API_SECRET renamed RELEASE_NONCE), and 7 more. Twin of "Twilio API key secret: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
